selection: October 1-31 is the first complete calendar month available inside the already declared January-October 2026 audit window, based only on directory availability. No October counts have yet been inspected.
models: Original quarterly ratio and the already selected 2021-only rule from correction-study.json. All parameters fit 2019-2021 with original exclusions, fixed before reading this new period. Do not switch to a better-performing alternative after inspecting October.
metric: Same polygon, confidence filters, exact duplicates and equal-area 1km occupied cell/day aggregation as global-185 pipeline. Keep 0.5-degree display bins and representative tie break unchanged.
baseline: Aqua full Octobers 2003-2017, historical median and p90; compare identical full-month dates.
report: Publish both countries and both frozen models. Report total-period signed/count discrepancy, daily WAPE, category agreement descriptively. One month cannot establish national category recall or full screening acceptance. Expose every daily file status; lack of detections is not cloud-free coverage.
interpretation: First new-to-us period evaluation of already frozen selected models. Not independent ground truth and not blind validation of the full development process; countries and earlier evaluation outcomes were already known. October NRT versus archive processing is a transfer boundary.
